BTC receives only a modest constructive adjustment because of liquidity and comparatively lower tail risk. ETH and SOL remain beta-sensitive with weak excess signal. BCH, DOGE, and LTC are fragile due to negative alpha, weak institutional/liquidity measures, and adverse expected shortfall. ETC is especially fragile: its zero price, zero volatility, and zero liquidity indicate unusable data, so its long signal should not be trusted.
